name: Sivagnanam Anisha
source: A 16 year old second year student who takes academic life very seriously, to the disdain of her peers. Her high standards prevent her from allowing others to get by on mediocrity, and drive her to speak her mind whenever she feels so inclined. She seems frustrated with Homura's lack of ambition and lethargic approach to life at such a high-class school.
